user.title: Connect to Sophos Firewall
user.description: Enter the HTTPS admin address and a Sophos Firewall REST API key.

rules.title: Choose firewall rules
rules.description: Select the IPv4 or IPv6 rules you want to control from Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the Sophos REST API key

error.invalid_host: Enter a firewall hostname or IP address.
error.invalid_auth: The firewall API key is missing or invalid.
error.permission_denied: The firewall denied API access. Check Home Assistant’s allowed IP and the administrator profile.
error.unsupported_firmware: The firewall REST API was not found. Sophos Firewall OS 23.0 or later is required.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Sophos HTTPS admin endpoint. Check the address, port, and TLS certificate.
error.unexpected_response: The firewall returned a response this integration could not read.
